lvl 42-59からlvl 60+の段階別ツリーへ進む。: Progress from the “lvl 42-59” to the “lvl 60+” staged tree.
弓、矢筒、ライフ、回避、属性耐性、移動速度、必要能力値。: Bow, quiver, Life, Evasion, elemental resistances, movement speed and required attributes.
スナイプがマナ不足で途中終了しないよう、ボス前にマナと消費量を確認する。: Before bosses, check mana and costs so Snipe does not stop early from insufficient mana.
キャンペーン終了。アイスショットの周回とスナイプの単体戦が安定している。: Finish the campaign with reliable Ice Shot clearing and Snipe single-target damage.
アイスショットを周回主力、スナイプを強敵用に使用: Use Ice Shot for clearing and Snipe against tough enemies.
EndgameガイドのEarly構成へ移行。: Move to the Early setup in the Endgame guide.
Earlyの非クリティカル・ライフ/回避型ツリーを使用。: Use the Early non-critical Life/Evasion tree.
三属性耐性、ライフ、回避、冷気・物理の追加アタックダメージ、弓と矢筒。: All three elemental resistances, Life, Evasion, added Cold and Physical attack damage, bow and quiver.
マップ開始時は原典のEarly非クリティカル型を使い、装備が揃う前にクリティカル: Start maps with the original Early non-critical setup. Do not switch to critical strikes before obtaining the gear.
低Tierマップを安定して周回でき、三属性耐性とライフ・回避が不足していない。: Clear low-tier maps consistently with adequate elemental resistances, Life and Evasion.
non-crit Midgameからnon-crit Hybrid swapの順: Progress from “non-crit Midgame” to “non-crit Hybrid swap” in that order.
原典のnon-crit Midgameを完成させ、装備条件を満たしてからHybr: Complete the original non-crit Midgame tree, then consider Hybrid swap after meeting its equipment requirements.
弓、矢筒、追加アタックダメージ、耐性、ライフ・回避。Hybrid移行時はESも確: Bow, quiver, added attack damage, resistances, Life and Evasion. Check Energy Shield when moving to Hybrid.
Hybridは自動的な上位互換ではない。装備とパッシブを半端に混ぜない。: Hybrid is not automatically an upgrade. Do not mix incomplete portions of its gear and passives with another setup.
非クリティカル型が安定し、Hybrid移行に必要な装備が揃う。: Stabilise the non-critical setup and obtain the equipment needed for the Hybrid transition.
アイスショットを主力に、装備が揃うまではスナイプを単体用として維持: Use Ice Shot as your main skill and retain Snipe for single targets until your gear is ready.
Crit HybridからUber Endgameは装備前提を満たす場合のみ移行: Move from Crit Hybrid to Uber Endgame only when the equipment requirements are met.
Crit Hybrid段階別ツリーを基準にし、Uber版は原典の装備条件を確認後: Use the Crit Hybrid staged tree as a baseline. Adopt the Uber version only after checking the original equipment requirements.
高性能な弓と矢筒、追加ダメージ、クリティカル、防御、耐性、必要能力値。: A strong bow and quiver, added damage, critical strikes, defences, resistances and required attributes.
装備が十分ならスナイプを外す選択肢もあるが、固定DPSや一撃条件は断定しない。: With sufficient gear, removing Snipe is an option, but do not assume fixed DPS or one-shot thresholds.
完成後は弓、単体火力、防御のボトルネックを1項目ずつ改善する。: After completing the setup, improve bow, single-target damage and defence bottlenecks one at a time.
